concurrency.scope: Owned warm Redis/Jena; bounded threaded HTTP acceptance, not production load capacity.
concurrency.consistency: Overlapping requests may see either committed state. All requests started after acknowledged revocation must deny access.

cache.scope: Owned synthetic Jena/Redis; sequential and bounded concurrent API requests; no production cache/load.
